# Slid Phi Labs — llms-full.txt (full digest)
# Primary host: https://www.slidphilabs.com

## Lab
Slid Phi Labs, Cherry Hill NJ. Contact corey@slidphilabs.com. License: AGPL-3.0-or-later OR commercial.

## Agent Rider (https://agentrider.fly.dev)
Signed names for agents plus Warrant permissions plus verifiable receipts.
Flow: POST /api/agents -> vault key ar_ (shown once) -> POST /api/rider/issue -> Rider JWT
(ES256, iss agentrider.dev, 15-minute TTL) -> send as X-Agent-Rider on metered calls.
Funded riders settle; sandbox riders are read/verify-only (funded settle returns sandbox_forbidden).
Verify via /.well-known/jwks.json or POST /api/rider/verify.
Refusals: {error, issue_url, docs_url} plus a Rider challenge.

## CuNi / CuNIverse (https://cuni-studio.fly.dev/)
One program, 53 targets, byte-identical stdout or the run refuses. CuNIverse: four organs.
Install: brew install slidphilabs/tap/cuni (as documented; no version claimed here).

## TeachAid (https://teachaid.fly.dev)
Chapter-by-chapter text and voice learning; PWA with chat, TTS, live sessions.
TeachAid Pro: $9/month (already public in TeachAid pricing; includes Pro voice picker).

## Hosted suite + PCC
Metered compression and jobs on lab machines. Billed per GB after the free allowance.
Free allowance: TBD — decided before launch.

## spl-acn client
Claim-token access to the hosted MCP. Canonical: https://www.slidphilabs.com/api/mcp.
Rider MCP: https://agentrider.fly.dev/api/mcp. Seat amounts not stated here.

## GitDepot
Team blob storage. Usage-metered; allowance TBD.

## Pricing rule
No prices are stated except CuNi capability promotion $9/month per capability
(Stripe, flag-gated, already public in Toll v2 promote docs) and TeachAid Pro $9/month
(already public in TeachAid pricing). All other meters name the meter, not the amount.
